summary: My brother, James Luther (Jimmy) Mathis, ‘73, died Nov. 23, 2021, after an 8-year battle with lymphoma. He lived in New Orleans and is survived by his children—Meg (23), Jack (22), and Joe (20) Mathis; his mother, Patricia Mathis; and sister, Paula Mathis, ‘70, both of Montgomery.
